fullContentHtml:
Download App Get Started for Free

The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has announced the CBSE Junior Assistant Result 2026 for tier 2 exams on 15th May 2026 [Friday] at its official website. The results have been announced along with the detailed category-wise cut off in the form of an online scorecard. All those candidates who appeared for the Group A, B, and C tier 2 recruitment examination can now check and download their online result PDFs by simply visiting the official website i.e., www.cbse.gov.in and logging in using their respective application number and password/date of birth. They can also access their online CBSE Group A, B, C Tier-2 Result by simply clicking on the direct link shared in the article below.

CBSE Group A, B, C Tier-2 Result 2026 Out

The CBSE Junior Assistant Tier 2 Recruitment examination 2026 is a national-level recruitment test held by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) to select candidates for various non-teaching posts, including the Assistant Secretary, Assistant Director, Accounts Officer, Superintendent, Junior Translation Officer, Junior Accountant, and Junior Assistant. After the successful completion of the exams between 18th April and 26th April 2026, candidates were eager to know the outcomes of their hard work. So this is to inform them that their wait is finally over with the announcement of the CBSE non-teaching tier 2 result 2026 on 15th May 2026. Candidates can now access their scorecards and prepare for the next step accordingly. 

CBSE Non Teaching Tier 2 Result 2026 PDF Download Link

The official window to access the activated online CBSE Junior Assistant Result 2026 has been activated by the CBSE on 15th May  2026. As the results have been published, candidates can now check and download their online CBSE Group A, B and C Tier 2 Result 2026 either through the official CBSE website www.cbse.gov.in or the link we have also shared in the article below. The online scorecards consist of details such as the candidate’s personal details, marks obtained, pass/fail status, and much more. Aspirants are advised to keep their application number and password handy.

CBSE Non-Teaching Tier 2 Result 2026 PDF OUT: Click to Check 

CBSE Junior Assistant Tier 2 Result 2026 – Highlights 

The official results for the CBSE Junior Assistant Tier 2 Recruitment examination 2026 have been announced along with the merit list and cut-off at the official CBSE website. For more updates regarding the tier 2 results candidates are advised to carefully go through the table shared below:

How to Check CBSE Junior Assistant Tier 2 Result 2026 at www.cbse.gov.in?

All those candidates who took the CBSE Junior Assistant Tier 2 recruitment examination 2026 can now check and download their online result PDF by simply following the detailed step-by-step process discussed below:

Step 1: Firstly, go to the official website of the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) https://www.cbse.gov.in/.

Step 2: Look for the ‘latest updates’ section on the homepage. And then click on the “CBSE Junior Assistant Tier 2 Result 2026” download link.

Step 3: Carefully enter your respective application number, password/date of birth and security pin as login credentials in the prescribed area.

Step 4: Once all the details are correctly filled, click on the submit button.

Step 5: The detailed CBSE non-teaching tier 2 Result 2026 PDF will be displayed on the screen.

Step 6: At the end, make sure to download and save the CBSE non-teaching tier 2 Result PDF for further reference. 

Details Mentioned on the CBSE Non-Teaching Tier 2 Result 2026

The online CBSE Non-Teaching Tier 2 scorecards consist of various essential details, so candidates are required to carefully go through them. If any error is found, they must immediately contact the Central Board of Secondary Education and get it rectified. Some of the details mentioned in the CBSE Junior Assistant tier 2 result have been discussed below. 

  • Candidate’s Name 
  • Application Number
  • Roll Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Category
  • Parent’s Name
  • Subject-wise marks obtained
  • Pass/Fail Status
  • Overall Scores.

CBSE Group A, B, C Tier-2 Cut Off 2026

Along with the result PDF, the board has also released category-wise CBSE Group A, B, and C tier-2 cut-off marks. It is to be noted that the cut varies every year and is based on the number of candidates who appeared, previous year trends and much more. Candidates can either check the category-wise cut off from the official CBSE website or through the table shared below:

CBSE Non-Teaching Tier 2 Result 2026: FAQs

Q1. Is the CBSE Non-Teaching Tier 2 Result 2026 announced?

Answer: Yes, CBSE Non-Teaching Tier 2 Result 2026 has been declared by the Central Board of Secondary Education on 15th May 2026.

Q2. What is the official website to check CBSE Junior Assistant Tier 2 Result 2026?

Answer: The CBSE Junior Assistant Tier 2 Result 2026 has been declared at the official website, i.e., www.cbse.gov.in.

Q3. What login credentials are required to download the CBSE Group A, B, and C tier 2 results 2026?

Answer: To access the online CBSE Group A, B, and C tier 2 results 2026 candidates are required to enter their respective application number and password/date of birth as login credentials.

Q4. What is the purpose of CBSE Non-Teaching Tier 2 recruitment examination 2026?

Answer: The CBSE Junior Assistant Tier 2 recruitment examination is held to select eligible candidates for various non-teaching posts, including the Assistant Secretary, Assistant Director, Accounts Officer, Superintendent, Junior Translation Officer, Junior Accountant, and Junior Assistant
